en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2232 - Abu Ja’far Imam Al-Baqir (as) said:

"Hajj and Umrah are two marketplaces from the marketplaces of the Hereafter. Those who adhere to them are the guests of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic. If He keeps them alive, they are kept without sin; and if He causes them to die, He enters them into Paradise."
